## Kling V3 Standard API

Kling V3 Standard is a text to video, image to video and motion control model by Kling AI, available on the Venice API as `kling-v3-standard-text-to-video`. Requests are anonymized, so the provider never sees your identity.

Kling V3 Standard is the balanced tier of Kling AI's V3 video model. This text-to-video variant generates 3- to 15-second clips, with optional audio.

### Kling V3 Standard API pricing

| Model ID | Variant | Privacy | Price |
|---|---|---|---|
| `kling-v3-standard-text-to-video` | Text to video | Anonymized | from $0.0925 / sec |
| `kling-v3-standard-image-to-video` | Image to video | Anonymized | from $0.0925 / sec |
| `kling-v3-standard-motion-control` | Motion control | Anonymized | priced by source |

### Kling V3 Standard specifications

| Spec | Value |
|---|---|
| Provider | Kling AI |
| Released | Feb 3, 2026 |
| Privacy | Anonymized |
| Status | Stable |
| Modes | text to video, image to video and motion control |
| Durations | 3–15s, any whole second |
| Aspect ratios | 16:9, 9:16, 1:1 |
| Audio | Optional |

### How to use the Kling V3 Standard API

Send requests to `POST https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/video/queue` with `"model": "kling-v3-standard-text-to-video"` and your API key.

```bash
# 1. Queue the job (returns a queue_id)
curl https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/video/queue \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $VENICE_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "model": "kling-v3-standard-text-to-video",
    "prompt": "Slow aerial drone shot over a misty mountain valley at golden hour",
    "duration": "5s",
    "aspect_ratio": "16:9",
    "audio": true
  }'

# 2. Poll until the MP4 is ready
curl https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/video/retrieve \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $VENICE_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{ "model": "kling-v3-standard-text-to-video", "queue_id": "<queue_id>" }' --output video.mp4
```
